endorsements.name: Rob Blakely
endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Automotive 2024 - Day One Results
endorsements.description: Rob Blakely from Cromulence successfully executed his attack on Automotive Grade Linux. However, an n-day exploit was used in the attack. He still earns $47,500 and 3.75 Master of Pwn Points.
endorsements.subtitle: Pwn2Own 2024
